translations.description_clean:
StellarRegulator Array
星规阵列

简介

《星规阵列》试图讲述一个拥有谜一般过去的神秘机械智能的故事，她以友好的姿态向你发起了一个“协议”，为你提供某些支援，但你似乎对将要付出的一无所知。

一个作为启动标志的国民理念“星规技术”允许你研究她提供的独特技术：基于某种奇妙材料的产业体系，以及以“最优方案”为设计理念的舰船组件，还有其他的许多东西。
你可以直接向她索取最顶端的技术，使用强大的舰船和巨型结构，又或者等待时间为你揭开科学道路的面纱。
一艘强大的旗舰同样可以靠与她交流激活的特殊项目获取，附带一系列强大的可操作技能。
同时，她还提供了一系列并无代价的援助，诸如优秀的领袖或强到很不合理的武装科研船，所有这些只需要你开口就行。
那么，这是为什么呢？

另一方面，国民理念“路希维亚帝国”允许你以更常规的视角体验不同但又有交集的故事。
在“陨落之矛”故事线中，你将在一个仿佛被定制化的事件链中与一个没有那么强大的星规阵列、还有她的创造者们相处，使用基础的科技扩张，探索，发掘群星间的秘密，借助一系列遗产强化你的帝国，并最终，应对意料之外的敌人，或者走向歧途。

增加内容

四层技术，不需要研究的基础产业，纯粹提供舰船组件的前两级，以及附带了产业升级的第三级，还有在游戏后期才能获取的极端强大的终极技术。

几乎纯粹的合金和能量币主导，不依赖稀有资源的消费体系。

强大的陆军，地面作战的最终解决方案，比纳米灾疫更加高效。

基于“星辉水晶”的新型建筑技术，以及一套完全自动化的独特星球建设模式。

一个强大到匪夷所思的终局危机势力，在完成“路希维亚遗痕”考古线后触发，其最高难度能让达到巅峰的文明也感到敬畏。

数个拥有独特立绘的角色，精心设计的闲聊对话。

已知问题

建造恒星基地的舰队界面按钮会错误调用星环基地的成本，不过你可以右键星系来造恒星基地。

战斗力溢出。但只有AI才依赖战斗力判断舰队强度，对吧。

某些依赖Game Rule运行的机制可能会因为文件被覆盖而不生效，不过无伤大雅。

若出现对话立绘缺失问题，请前往换装界面重设。

立绘加载时可能的闪动，这受限于button显示立绘的实现方式。

特殊对话UI无法使用滚轮滑动文字，请使用位于对话框右侧的滑条。

平衡性

平衡？拜托，这又不是电竞游戏。

天灾的难度分级适配从常规运营到接近作弊水平的庞大强度层级，几乎所有人都能找到拥有挑战性的难度，但显然大多数时候战争完全由你的决定左右，其他势力缺少参与战斗的强度。

远高于原版常规数值的数值体系，并且高度简化，如果你不想只是单纯的欺负AI，你可以尝试自定义拥有“星规技术”国民理念的预设国家并强制其生成。

如何反馈建议或BUG

mod讨论群号：937419692
询问，反馈bug和参与mod制作
工坊的评论区会被浏览但不会被追踪。
Discord频道：https://discord.gg/pKhZWx44Kd

以下反馈不会被处理
工坊或启动器的问题：工坊订阅了不生效、启动器无法启用mod等。
自己导致的问题：不会安装MOD、未安装最新版并反馈旧版BUG等。
乱贴error.log：这个log几乎不会记录任何有关崩溃的信息，许多条目不会对游戏有任何影响，也请不要拿这个去烦别的作者。
原版的问题：领袖在基因/灵能飞升后变头像、人类种族国家没有生成、外交/物种界面动画抽搐、领袖界面卡等。
对BUG的胡乱猜测：请谨记遇到BUG只是观察到一个表象，除非准确定位到了源头，否则不要一知半解地散布自己臆测出的谣言。例：我开局合金怎么是0，我怀疑作者把物种写到建筑里去了。
不负责任的反馈：开着200多个mod问为什么闪退、由于缺乏阅读能力问出的问题等。

其他

代码兼容性
完全兼容，涉及覆盖的代码实现均为低优先级，与星规阵列存在严重冲突的mod没有兼容性可言

This mod adds over 70 new Ascension Perks to the game, 8+ of which are further extensions of vanilla perks, 10+ of which are entirely new creations with different effects, and 50+ of which are tiers 2, 3, 4, and 5 of the other perks. You can choose at the start of the game to enable or disable the tiered perks and if you change your mind you'll find a new edict that lets you make the choice again.

translations.description_clean:
With this Mod you can build as many Megastructures as you want, limited only by the resources you have. Any empire that has the materials to build two Dyson-Spheres at once should also have the needed manpower. Now you can build with no restrictions.*

*See back of the box for terms and conditions
Important info
If you want to build multiple megastructures around a star make sure you construct the megastructure construction site for all of them early. Some Megastructures block clicking on the star, so it might show you that you can build there but you will always only click the mega structure covering the star.
General changes
[*]Build limites lifted, I changed every megastucture so it would not count towards the Mega structure build limit.
[*]I lifted restrictions on placements, I removed as many as possible while still keeping some lore sense and some overlapping preventions, but it might be possible to end up with intersecting models.
[*]I removed star restrictions, Ringsworld and  Dyson Structures, They all needed to be around some very specific starts. Now you can have 3 Dyson spheres around Trisolar systems and have a ringworld around a black hole.
[*]The "one megastructure per system" rule is also gone! Do you want to have a Galactic assembly overseeing a Ringworld around a black hole incaseed in a dyson sphere? sure, why not!


due to popular demand Ko-fi.com/flemmi <- i hope hot chocolate is ok too.

FAQ
Is this Mod compatible with Gigastructures?
No! Gigastructural Engineering simply has too many conflicts with this mod. GE offers its own lighter restrictions on Megastructure construction however, so a bit of adjustment is possible within that mod already. It was pointed out to me that GE does not allow truly unlimited building however.

 Content 
Current, but not final Sci-Fi sections and animated portraits are listed below: 
•	Babylon 5 – 1 animated (narn); 
•	Mass Effect – about half animated (from EDI, prothean to geth, kett)
•	Star Wars – about half animated (mirialan, zabrak, twi’lek, togruta, sith, chiss, sullustan, jawa, rodian, neimodians, duros)

•	Miscellaneous races – na'vi from Avatar, xenomorph, terminator, 2 Star Gate races and 3 PlanetSide factions animated, protoss;

•	Halo – Cortana, UNCS, prehuman, covenant races;
•	Doctor Who – all races static;
•	Warhammer 40k – all races static;
•	XCOM – all races static.
•	Fantasy - all races animated.

There are also included name lists and planets/systems, but other modifications (prescr. empires, race traits, overhauls, predefinitions) are NOT included as my idea is to make it as universal as possible. If you need additional traits, you can get them from this [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=850721710] awesome mod  inspired by various sci-fi themes.

 Random spawning and type of races

 Conflicting mods

 Also:

The transfer is possible in the form of a gift, and you can to demand different types of resources for the fleet: energy credits, minerals, food, consumer goods, alloys.
Mod automatically calculates the market price of the fleets and gives price options to the player to choose for sale, in percentage terms - from a symbolic amount to brazen robbery. Of course, you can set the price manually.

2. Fleet market
On market you can exhibit up to 6 different fleets for manually set price. By exhibiting fleet, seller loses the ability to control it. Each player can inspect the exhibited fleet and buy it. If the fleet has not been bought within five years, it will be returned to the seller.

3. Fleet rent
The function is similar to the Fleet Market, with the difference that the buyer does not receive the fleet forever, but for the time set by the seller. In addition, if the buyer destroys the rented fleet, compensation can be claimed from him or you can impose sanctions on him at all.

4. Fleet auction
The function is similar to the Fleet Market, with the difference that there are only three slots for setting fleets, the sale time is limited to one year, and the buyer is the one who offers the highest bet for this year.


Possible questions:

"If I get a fleet with components that I have not yet learned, do I get them automatically?"
No, these components still need to be studied for installation on your ships. But already installed components from ships will not go anywhere, only if you try to modify ships that have components better than you have studied - you will install your components, not the better ones!

"Can empires like devouring swarms use these functions?"
No. They hate other races.

"Why it is not allowed to transfer or sell transport ships with armies?"
At current moment while you are transferring armies they bugged and it’s impossible to use them. Until a solution is found - transport ships with armies is not transmitted.

"I transferred/sold/bought titans, and my counter of them has broken!"
Such a problem exists. Solution - re-enter in the game. We advise you do not abuse the sale of titans.

"Can I sell federation fleet?"
No. The federation fleet does not belong to one owner, even if it is the Hegemon - it belongs to the entire federation at once.

"Why I can't to exhibit on Market/Rent/Auction my colossus or juggernaut?"
Colossus or Juggernauts can be transferred or sold ONLY in the Fleet Transfer Menu. Open trading of such ships is prohibited.

"How can I disable some functions of the mod?"
"How to forbid AI use functions of the mod?"
This can be done in the mod settings window. To get there, you need to open the market, rental or auction window, and in the top left corner, near the close button of the window, press on the settings button. If these functions are already disabled, the settings button will appear in the fleet transfer menu.

The Zenith of Fallen Empires 3.0 is now [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2044599287]LIVE

The Zenith of Fallen Empires 1.0 will continue to work with Game Updates 1.9, while 3.0 will be supported beyond the 2.6 Federations update.



The Zenith of Fallen Empires retraces the steps of the Fallen, their rise to the pinnacle of civilization and military might.  Going back several millennia, the galaxy was dominated by massive, technologically advanced weapons with each ‘Fallen’ Empire trying to outdo the other at every opportunity, inventing new weapons, each of them more dangerous than the last. You will have a chance to reach the zenith of technological advancement, and perhaps one day, become what the Fallen Empires were.

Q: I didnt get notification that Unbidden spawned and I cant discover them?

A: As indicated in Compatibility, any mods you have that overwrites the crisis events file will introduce incompatibility, and that incompatibility being the scripted contact that triggers for normal empires when a crisis spawns. New empire types from this mod are originally not included in that list, and thus I have overwritten that vanilla file for this specific reason. If another mod overwrites my overwrite, you won't be able to contact crises and the event chain won't fire in the normal way. Either use 'Communications' command or create your own compatibility patch that combines the changes in my overwrite with the overwrite of whichever mod that introduces the incompatibility.

Q: How does Ascended Empire's naval capacity work?

You are free to alter this naval cap as you see fit, and as of 1.8, AE naval cap now increases by each planet owned.

Simply increases the maximum impact of Relative Navy Strength from 50 to 150, making the AI surrender much faster in unwinnable wars. Also applies in the negative direction, so an enemy with overwhelming fleet power will have -150 to surrendering rather than -50.

[url="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3541920643"]Alternative Version that sets the maximum to 100.

translations.gameplay_zh_current: 这是一个纯数值调整小 MOD：把「相对海军强度」对 AI 投降意愿的最大影响从 50 提升到 150，让 AI 在必败战争中投降得明显更快。负方向同样生效——面对军力碾压的敌人，其投降意愿惩罚从 -50 变成 -150，让实力差距在战争结算中体现得更极端。另有将上限设置为 100 的版本可供选择。
translations.reviews_zh_current: 订阅 3.4 万、收藏 1975。把相对海军强度对投降意愿的最大影响从 50 提升到 150，让 AI 更快投降。
translations.features_zh_current: ["海军强度影响 50→150", "AI 投降显著加速", "可选 100 上限版本"]

• 兼容性：面向 3.2 及更旧版本设计，安装后直接生效，无需额外设置。
适合在意视觉效果、或对大量光环特效感到视觉疲劳的玩家。

Are you looking for more action and interesting events to show up while you are doing your day to day enslaving and conquering business? If, like us, you find the mid to late game a little lacking of interesting diversion, then you have come to the right place. This mod adds new anomalies and events to your game, focusing on spicing up the game after exploration has slowed down.

Note: There have been some slight changes to the galactic_features_events.txt

ACHIEVEMENTS WILL BE DISABLED WHEN USING THIS MOD

Mod Content
Anomalies, Events and Archaeological sites to add more variety to your gaming expierience. Additionally there are various new species portraits (used for our factions) which are also accessable for custom empires, but they will not spawn as randomly generated empires.
Also this mod adds deactivatable planetary shield graphics as well as an also deactivatable alternative version of the shieldworld planets.

[url=http://more-events-mod.wikidot.com/]https://i.postimg.cc/0N2QPFcS/wiki-logo-150-2.png
Our Wiki is still under construction. Everyone is welcome to add info to it they would expect to see there.

Bug Reports
You found a bug during your game session? Please, post it in the Bug report discussion thread so we can squish it in the next version. And if you could give us some hints on how to reproduce it, it would be also very helpful.

FAQ
Q: Is this or that event from your mod?
A: First, open your console while the event window is still there. Then type in "debugtooltip" and press enter, then close the console. Now check the tooltip when hovering your mouse over one of the event's options. It displays the event_id among other information. All of our event_ids start mit "mem_". If there's no "mem_" it's not from us.

A: The Vazuran Menace can be completely disabled by unselecting the Vazuran Menace precursor button in the pregame selection.

You also won't be throwing your money into the aether either, as we have clear goals on what to do next with donated funds - visible on that page. 本 MOD 将传统槽位扩展到 63 个、飞升槽位扩展到 64 个，属于「传统 UI」系列的槽位扩展子 MOD。无法单独使用，必须搭配「传统 UI」系列 MOD 之一：传统 UI 4.0、3.14~3.12、3.10~3.11、3.1~3.9（各有低分辨率版本）。
• 先启用传统 UI 对应版本的 MOD，再启用本 MOD
• 不同游戏版本选择对应的传统 UI 分支，低分辨率版本供低配玩家选择
• 同系列还有 12/16/24/32/48/64/128/256 传统槽位 + 对应飞升槽位版本，按需选一个
• 选择档位时考虑实际安装的传统/飞升 MOD 数量，避免槽位过少或过多
• 纯槽位扩展，不新增任何传统或飞升内容
• 启用后传统与飞升界面会出现更多空槽位，可直接摆放额外传统
• 适合装了大量传统/飞升类 MOD、需要更多摆放槽位的重度玩家
